name: The T2K Experiment
notes: Journal reference Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 659 (2011) 106-135.

summary.plain: The main reference paper describing how the T2K experiment works: the accelerator, the neutrino beamline, and the near and far detectors.
summary.technical: Comprehensive T2K instrumentation paper: J-PARC main-ring beam, off-axis neutrino beamline (target, horns, decay volume), INGRID on-axis and ND280 off-axis near detectors, and the Super-Kamiokande far detector, published as the experiment began physics data taking.
